regions.breakdown: 「伊佐沼」 (Isanuma) is a specific place name (a marsh or pond), and 「通り」 (dōri) means street or road. Together they form 'Isanuma Street'.

where_youd_see_it: On a road sign indicating the name of a street or route, typically at an intersection.
cultural_note: Japanese road signs frequently provide both Japanese characters (Kanji/Hiragana/Katakana) and their romanized (English alphabet) equivalents, making them accessible to international visitors or those who cannot read Japanese script.
